summary: Claude Startups continues to offer Startup Stack partner discounts and credits worth up to $45,000, subject to partner terms, plus Applied AI office hours and events. The current official FAQ says the free year of Claude Team and $1,000 API credit offers are over capacity, so new applicants should not expect guaranteed Team access or API credits. Already-claimed offers are unchanged. Anthropic is re-reviewing applications, which may change some application statuses; the ongoing partner program has not ended.
claim_steps: Sign in to Claude Console and apply through https://claude.com/programs/startups.
Read the current FAQ before applying: the Claude Team and $1,000 API credit offers are over capacity and are not guaranteed for new applicants.
If accepted, redeem available Startup Stack offers in Claude Console and check each independent partner's terms and eligibility.
If you already claimed the Team or API offer, the FAQ says nothing changes; use the claimed offer in your account. Watch for application re-review updates.

social_proof.title: Claude for Startups program | Claude by Anthropic
social_proof.text:
we’re currently over capacity on the Claude Team and $1,000 API credit offers. If you’ve already claimed the offer, nothing changes; you can use the offer in the account.
All existing members will still have full access to the Startup Stack, Applied AI office hours and events, and if you’re on a Claude Max or Team plan, your monthly API credits are available in Console as usual.
